narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video humorously captures the emotional shift of parents who, after tearfully seeing their children off on a school trip, immediately transition to a high-energy celebration at a KTV lounge to enjoy their temporary freedom.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The contrast between the sentimental farewell and the wild karaoke party creates a relatable comedic effect for parents.
